svg.title: StormCloud wiring: ESP32 DevKit V1
svg.text: Top view, USB at the bottom. Pin order matches the board silkscreen. Pins in colour are used; grey are free.
step it; wraps past either end
hold: one segment lit, storm paused
while holding, the segment to light
Type into pio device monitor. Each change prints
a [keys] line, and the dashboard follows.
size it, or cap it in code
Input only (GPIO34–39): no output, no internal pull-up. Wrong for the button.
Every ground symbol joins a GND pin. Both GND pins on the board are the same net.
No knobs: palette, speed and level are set from the computer's keyboard through the serial monitor, over the same USB cable.
Strip data is 3.3 V into a 5 V strip. Short runs usually work. If the first pixel glitches, add a 74AHCT125 level shifter before the 330 Ω.
EN resets the board. Hold BOOT while tapping EN to force the flasher, only if an upload will not start on its own.
